spans.s:
स्नेह, अस्, m. oiliness, unctuousness, fattiness,
greasiness, lubricity, viscidity (as one of the twenty-
four Guṇas of the Vaiśeṣika branch of the Nyāya
phil.); moisture; blandness, tenderness, love, affec-
tion, kindness; filial love or affection; any unctuous
or oleaginous substance, oil, grease, fat, an unguent;
a fluid of the body; (आस्), m. pl., N. of a caste (cor-
responding to the Vaiśyas).
—स्नेह-गुणित, अस्, आ,
अम्, endowed with love or affection.
—स्नेह-च्छेद,
अस्, m. interruption of friendship, cessation or loss of
regard.
—स्नेह-पक्व, अस्, आ, अम्, cooked or
dressed with oil.
—स्नेह-पात्र, अम्, n. a worthy
object of affection.
—स्नेह-पूर्वम्, ind. preceded
by affection, affectionately, tenderly, fondly.
—स्नेह-
प्रवृत्ति, इस्, f. ‘course of friendship,’ affection,
love.
—स्नेह-प्रिय, अस्, आ, अम्, fond of oil; (अस्),
m. a lamp.
—स्नेह-भाण्ड, अम्, n. an oil-vessel,
pot of oil.
—स्नेहभाण्ड-जीविन्, ई, m. living by
oil-vessels, an oilman.
—स्नेह-भू, ऊस्, m. phlegm,
rheum, the phlegmatic humor.
—स्नेह-भूमि, इस्,
f. ‘oil-ground, oil-source,’ any substance yielding oil
or grease; any object of affection, one worthy of
love.
—स्नेह-रङ्ग, अस्, m. ‘oil-coloured,’ se-
samum.
—स्नेह-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, unctuous, oily;
possessed of affection, affectionate; (अती), f. = मेदा
(according to Śabda-k.).
—स्नेह-वस्ति, इस्, f. a
clyster or injection of oil, oily enema.
—स्नेह-विद्-
ध, अस्, m. ‘pierced or impregnated with oil,’ a
sort of pine, Pinus Devadaru (according to Śabda-k.
अम्, n.).
—स्नेह-विमर्दित, अस्, आ, अम्, rubbed or
anointed with oil.
—स्नेह-वीज, अस्, आ, अम्, having
oily seeds, causing unctuousness, &c.; (अस्), m. the
Piyāla tree.
—स्नेह-व्यक्ति, इस्, f. manifestation or
display of friendship.
—स्नेह-संयुक्त, अस्, आ, अम्,
mixed with oil, dressed with ghee, (Manu

.)
—स्नेह-सम्भाष, अस्, m. kind conversation.
—स्नेहाक्त (˚ह-अक्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, anointed with
oil, oiled, greased, lubricated.
—स्नेहानुवृत्ति (˚ह-
अन्˚), इस्, f. continuance of affection, affectionate or
friendly intercourse.
—स्नेहाश (˚ह-आश), अस्, m.
‘oil-consumer,’ a lamp.
स्नेह स्नेह, स्नेहिन्. See p. 1149, col. 3.

स्नेहन्, आ, m. a friend; the moon; a kind of
disease.

स्नेहन, अस्, ई, अम्, anointing, lubricating; de-
stroying; (अस्), m. epithet of Śiva; (अम्), n. the act
of anointing, unction, lubrication, rubbing or smear-
ing with oil or unguents; unctuousness, being or
becoming oily, &c.; an emollient, unguent, lini-
ment.

स्नेहनीय, अस्, आ, अम्, to be anointed or lubri-
cated; to be loved.

स्नेहयत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, Ved. destroying, killing,
murdering.
स्नेहितव्य, अस्, आ, अम्, = स्नेहनीय above.

स्नेहिती, f., Ved. destroying, killing; [cf. स्नीहिती
above.]

स्नेहु, उस्, m. the moon; a kind of disease; [cf.
स्नेहन्.]
